# schema/cursor_token_placeholder — valid spec produces no diagnostics and exits 0
# No testserver needed; validate performs static analysis only.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    initial_interval:
      type: duration
      default: "720h"
    page_size:
      type: int
      default: 5
    api_key:
      type: secret
      default: "test-bearer-token-12345"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.api_key}

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/findings/keepalive
    query:
      cursor: {from_pagination: token}
      limit: {format: string, value: {ref: state.page_size}}

# placeholder_event is emitted when the server returns an empty events list
# but a non-empty pagination token. This signals a keepalive / warmup page:
# the drain continues without emitting real events. Motivating patterns:
# Splunk wait phase, ESET Protect keep-alive. Progress is stateless because
# latest_event_timestamp would crash on an empty warmup page.
response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.findings
  placeholder_event:
    object:
      keepalive: true
      source: keepalive

pagination:
  cursor_token:
    token_at: response.body.next_cursor
    send_as: query.cursor

progress:
  stateless: {}

error:
  mode: standard
